spans.s:
गु 1. गु (related to 1. गा), cl. 1. A. ग-
वते, to go.

गु 3. गु, cl. 1. A., Ved. गवते, जुगुवे,
गोष्यते, अगोष्ट, गोतुम्, (this verb seems
only to occur in the reduplicated forms जोगुवे and
जोगुवान), to speak articulately, to proclaim, to
cause to sound: Caus. गावयति: Desid. जुगूषते:
Intens. जोगूयते, जोगोति, to shout with joy; [cf.
जोगू.]

गु 4. गु, cl. 6. P. गुवति, जुगाव, गुष्यति,
अगुषीत्, गुतुम् or गुवितुम्, to void by stool,
to void excrement.

गु 5. गु (at the end of an adj. comp.)
= गो, a cow, cattle, earth, ray, &c., see गो, (e. g.
दश-गु, possessing ten cows; सहस्र-गु, possess-
ing 1000 cows; चलद्-गु, one under whom the earth
trembles, &c.); [cf. अनु-गु, अरिष्ट-गु, उष्ण-गु,
कृश-गु, &c.]

गू 1. गू, cl. 6. P. गुवति, to void by stool;
(another form for 4. गु.)

गू 2. गू (fr. rt. 1. गम्), going, (in अग्रे-गू,
q. v.)
